paragraphs.text: Now we beseech you, brethren, touching the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and our gathering together unto him;
paragraphs.original: Ἐρωτῶμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, ὑπὲρ τῆς παρουσίας τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἡμῶν ἐπισυναγωγῆς ἐπʼ αὐτόν,
paragraphs.translit: Erōtōmen de hymas, adelphoi, hyper tēs parousias tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou kai hēmōn episynagōgēs epʼ auton,

paragraphs.text: to the end that ye be not quickly shaken from your mind, nor yet be troubled, either by spirit, or by word, or by epistle as from us, as that the day of the Lord is just at hand;
paragraphs.original: εἰς τὸ μὴ ταχέως σαλευθῆναι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τοῦ νοὸς μηδὲ θροεῖσθαι μήτε διὰ πνεύματος μήτε διὰ λόγου μήτε διʼ ἐπιστολῆς ὡς διʼ ἡμῶν, ὡς ὅτι ἐνέστηκεν ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ κυρίου.
paragraphs.translit: eis to mē tacheōs saleuthēnai hymas apo tou noos mēde throeisthai mēte dia pneumatos mēte dia logou mēte diʼ epistolēs hōs diʼ hēmōn, hōs hoti enestēken hē hēmera tou kyriou.

paragraphs.text: let no man beguile you in any wise: for [it will not be,] except the falling away come first, and the man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition,
paragraphs.original: μή τις ὑμᾶς ἐξαπατήσῃ κατὰ μηδένα τρόπον· ὅτι ἐὰν μὴ ἔλθῃ ἡ ἀποστασία πρῶτον καὶ ἀποκαλυφθῇ ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς ἀνομίας, ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας,
paragraphs.translit: mē tis hymas exapatēsē kata mēdena tropon· hoti ean mē elthē hē apostasia prōton kai apokalyphthē ho anthrōpos tēs anomias, ho hyios tēs apōleias,

paragraphs.text: he that opposeth and exalteth himself against all that is called God or that is worshipped; so that he sitteth in the temple of God, setting himself forth as God.
paragraphs.original: ὁ ἀντικείμενος καὶ ὑπεραιρόμενος ἐπὶ πάντα λεγόμενον θεὸν ἢ σέβασμα, ὥστε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ θεοῦ καθίσαι ἀποδεικνύντα ἑαυτὸν ὅτι ἔστιν θεός.
paragraphs.translit: ho antikeimenos kai hyperairomenos epi panta legomenon theon ē sebasma, hōste auton eis ton naon tou theou kathisai apodeiknynta heauton hoti estin theos.

paragraphs.text: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
paragraphs.original: οὐ μνημονεύετε ὅτι ἔτι ὢν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ταῦτα ἔλεγον ὑμῖν;
paragraphs.translit: ou mnēmoneuete hoti eti ōn pros hymas tauta elegon hymin;

paragraphs.text: And now ye know that which restraineth, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
paragraphs.original: καὶ νῦν τὸ κατέχον οἴδατε, εἰς τὸ ἀποκαλυφθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἑαυτοῦ καιρῷ·
paragraphs.translit: kai nyn to katechon oidate, eis to apokalyphthēnai auton en tō heautou kairō·

paragraphs.text: For the mystery of lawlessness doth already work: only [there is] one that restraineth now, until he be taken out of the way.
paragraphs.original: τὸ γὰρ μυστήριον ἤδη ἐνεργεῖται τῆς ἀνομίας· μόνον ὁ κατέχων ἄρτι ἕως ἐκ μέσου γένηται.
paragraphs.translit: to gar mystērion ēdē energeitai tēs anomias· monon ho katechōn arti heōs ek mesou genētai.

paragraphs.text: And then shall be revealed the lawless one, whom the Lord Jesus shall slay with the breath of his mouth, and bring to nought by the manifestation of his coming;
paragraphs.original: καὶ τότε ἀποκαλυφθήσεται ὁ ἄνομος, ὃν ὁ κύριος Ἰησοῦς ἀνελεῖ τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ καὶ καταργήσει τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: kai tote apokalyphthēsetai ho anomos, hon ho kyrios Iēsous anelei tō pneumati tou stomatos autou kai katargēsei tē epiphaneia tēs parousias autou,

paragraphs.text: [even he], whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
paragraphs.original: οὗ ἐστιν ἡ παρουσία κατʼ ἐνέργειαν τοῦ Σατανᾶ ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει καὶ σημείοις καὶ τέρασιν ψεύδους
paragraphs.translit: hou estin hē parousia katʼ energeian tou Satana en pasē dynamei kai sēmeiois kai terasin pseudous

paragraphs.text: and with all deceit of unrighteousness for them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐν πάσῃ ἀπάτῃ ἀδικίας τοῖς ἀπολλυμένοις, ἀνθʼ ὧν τὴν ἀγάπην τῆς ἀληθείας οὐκ ἐδέξαντο εἰς τὸ σωθῆναι αὐτούς·
paragraphs.translit: kai en pasē apatē adikias tois apollymenois, anthʼ hōn tēn agapēn tēs alētheias ouk edexanto eis to sōthēnai autous·

paragraphs.text: And for this cause God sendeth them a working of error, that they should believe a lie:
paragraphs.original: καὶ διὰ τοῦτο πέμπει αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς ἐνέργειαν πλάνης εἰς τὸ πιστεῦσαι αὐτοὺς τῷ ψεύδει,
paragraphs.translit: kai dia touto pempei autois ho theos energeian planēs eis to pisteusai autous tō pseudei,

paragraphs.text: that they all might be judged who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα κριθῶσιν πάντες οἱ μὴ πιστεύσαντες τῇ ἀληθείᾳ ἀλλὰ εὐδοκήσαντες τῇ ἀδικίᾳ.
paragraphs.translit: hina krithōsin pantes hoi mē pisteusantes tē alētheia alla eudokēsantes tē adikia.

paragraphs.text: But we are bound to give thanks to God always for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, for that God chose you from the beginning unto salvation in sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
paragraphs.original: Ἡμεῖς δὲ ὀφείλομεν εὐχαριστεῖν τῷ θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοὶ ἠγαπημένοι ὑπὸ κυρίου, ὅτι εἵλατο ὑμᾶς ὁ θεὸς ἀπαρχὴν εἰς σωτηρίαν ἐν ἁγιασμῷ πνεύματος καὶ πίστει ἀληθείας,
paragraphs.translit: Hēmeis de opheilomen eucharistein tō theō pantote peri hymōn, adelphoi ēgapēmenoi hypo kyriou, hoti heilato hymas ho theos aparchēn eis sōtērian en hagiasmō pneumatos kai pistei alētheias,

paragraphs.text: whereunto he called you through our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
paragraphs.original: εἰς ὃ ἐκάλεσεν ὑμᾶς διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ἡμῶν, εἰς περιποίησιν δόξης τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: eis ho ekalesen hymas dia tou euangeliou hēmōn, eis peripoiēsin doxēs tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou.

paragraphs.text: So then, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye were taught, whether by word, or by epistle of ours.
paragraphs.original: ἄρα οὖν, ἀδελφοί, στήκετε, καὶ κρατεῖτε τὰς παραδόσεις ἃς ἐδιδάχθητε εἴτε διὰ λόγου εἴτε διʼ ἐπιστολῆς ἡμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: ara oun, adelphoi, stēkete, kai krateite tas paradoseis has edidachthēte eite dia logou eite diʼ epistolēs hēmōn.

paragraphs.text: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
paragraphs.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς καὶ θεὸς ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν, ὁ ἀγαπήσας ἡμᾶς καὶ δοὺς παράκλησιν αἰωνίαν καὶ ἐλπίδα ἀγαθὴν ἐν χάριτι,
paragraphs.translit: Autos de ho kyrios hēmōn Iēsous Christos kai theos ho patēr hēmōn, ho agapēsas hēmas kai dous paraklēsin aiōnian kai elpida agathēn en chariti,

paragraphs.text: comfort your hearts and establish them in every good work and word.
paragraphs.original: παρακαλέσαι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας καὶ στηρίξαι ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ καὶ λόγῳ ἀγαθῷ.
paragraphs.translit: parakalesai hymōn tas kardias kai stērixai en panti ergō kai logō agathō.
